title: Laparoscopic Versus Robot-assisted Inguinal Hernia Repair: A Single Institution Randomized Controlled Trial
brief_summary: Randomized trial to compare outcomes of laparoscopic and robot assisted inguinal hernia repair.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* surgeon determined need for inguinal hernia repair

Exclusion Criteria:

* \< 18 years of age
* \> 99 years of age
* medical indication for open repair
